industrial_00.name: Inspection Wasp
industrial_00.visual: Triangular wedge shell, one large circular camera eye, two horizontal cylinder thrusters, small stabilizer fins and a long telescoping needle under the center. Keep the entire silhouette visibly nose-down.
industrial_00.pivots: Independently swivel both thrusters; telescope the needle; roll the shell into dives; eye emissive state controls warnings.
industrial_00.ai: Orbits at 3–6 u range. Chooses Probe Dive when aligned, Scanner Sting at medium range, and Strafe when cornered. Body tilts with velocity, then returns upright.

moves.name: Probe Dive
moves.tell: 0.50 s: nose pitches down, eye turns red and a narrow lane appears
moves.effect: Lunges along locked lane for 9 damage (up to 5 u).
moves.recovery: 0.55 s wobble to stabilize with needle extended.

moves.name: Scanner Sting
moves.tell: 0.70 s: thin targeting beam fixes a direction
moves.effect: Fires one electrical pulse for 7 damage along the beam.
moves.recovery: 0.35 s eye shutter closes and reopens.

moves.name: Evasive Strafe
moves.tell: 0.20 s: one side thruster flashes
moves.effect: Sideways burst 2.0 u; deals no damage.

industrial_00.elite: Two inspection needles and orange-edged wing fins; follows the first dive with a second separately warned dive after a 0.35 s realignment. Elite HP 53.
industrial_00.death: 0.0–0.25 s rotor desynchronization; 0.25–0.65 s spiral drop; 0.65–1.1 s three-piece impact scatter; eye light flickers out.

industrial_01.name: Dust Mites
industrial_01.dimensions: 0.35 × 0.35 × 0.35 u each; hover 0.35 u; base pack 6
industrial_01.visual: Each bot is a flattened sphere, single central eye, two tiny cylinder side thrusters, and one visible circular brush disk below. Give individual bots 5–10% scale variations; six bodies form a loose flock.
industrial_01.pivots: Spin brush and thrusters separately; eye is one warning element; each unit has its own hover pivot and knockback.
industrial_01.ai: Loose flocking around the player; attacks staggered. Six units maximum for a standard group. No stacking contact damage in one hit window.

moves.name: Brush Strike
moves.tell: 0.35 s: one eye flashes red and brush spins faster
moves.effect: Unit darts 0.9 u for 4 contact damage. Shared victim hit cooldown prevents simultaneous chip hits.

moves.name: Swarm Rush
moves.tell: 0.80 s: all surviving eyes flash in sync and group compresses
moves.effect: Coordinated multi-bot dive; up to 12 total damage from the entire wave.

moves.name: Regroup
moves.tell: 0.40 s: lights shift cyan and movement slows
moves.effect: Units converge into a 1.2 u formation; no damage, prepares the next Rush.

industrial_01.elite: One visibly larger command bot (24 HP) conducts two Rush waves separated by 0.65 s. Destroying it restores normal uncoordinated behavior.
industrial_01.death: Each destroyed bot sparks, loses altitude in 0.2 s, bounces once, and rolls to rest for 0.5 s before disappearing; surviving units do not pause.

industrial_02.name: Pressure Purger
industrial_02.visual: Tall vertical cylinder with an octagonal plinth, eight evenly spaced rectangular vents, four bracing pistons, front pressure dial and rotating warning beacon. Large circular plan-view silhouette.
industrial_02.pivots: One pivot for each port flap, one for the beacon, four for stabilizer pistons, and one gauge needle.
industrial_02.ai: Moves to open central space, anchors before major attacks, and cannot turn once a sweep begins. Puddles disappear clearly.

moves.name: Steam Ring
moves.tell: 1.10 s: stabilizers extend; circular floor decal grows
moves.effect: Expanding steam ring deals 18 damage when crossed.

moves.name: Vent Sweep
moves.tell: 0.70 s: front vent opens and 90° cone is marked
moves.effect: Sweeps hot steam through cone for 12 damage.

moves.name: Chemical Overflow
moves.tell: 0.90 s: liquid leaks at the base inside a marked circle
moves.effect: Leaves a corrosive puddle for 3 s; proposed 3 damage/s, nonstacking.

industrial_02.elite: Two independently telegraphed steam rings separated by 0.70 s; second ring has a smaller safe inner radius. Elite HP 165.
industrial_02.death: Gauge needle pegs; 0.25 s bolts pop; 0.4 s harmless venting; 0.5 s cylinder buckles onto its base. Final cloud cannot damage.

industrial_03.name: Spanner Guard
industrial_03.visual: Rectangular chest, squat cylindrical head with visor slit, broad box shoulders, piston forearms, oversized wrench hands, short blocky shins and heavy boot prisms.
industrial_03.pivots: Separate shoulder yaw, elbow hinge, wrist/tool rotation, torso twist, hips and knees. Place hitboxes on wrench arcs, not whole arms.
industrial_03.ai: Closes to 1.4 u and generally uses the two-hit string. Uses overhead crush separately against a stationary target. Each slash has a discrete damage window.

moves.name: Wrench Slash 1
moves.tell: 0.45 s: right wrench draws back; a 100° arc appears
moves.effect: Horizontal swipe for 9 damage.
moves.recovery: 0.20 s arm follow-through; links into Slash 2.

moves.name: Wrench Slash 2
moves.tell: 0.30 s: torso counter-rotates and left wrench cocks
moves.effect: Reverse swing for 11 damage.

moves.name: Overhead Crush
moves.tell: 0.90 s: both wrenches lift over head; short floor rectangle lights
moves.effect: Downward smash for 19 damage.
moves.recovery: 0.90 s wrenches stuck briefly in floor.

industrial_03.elite: Brass shoulder collar and longer wrench handles. Adds Overhead Crush as a delayed third strike after Slash 2 with its full 0.90 s warning. Elite HP 135.
industrial_03.death: Drops one wrench first, backward torso tip, knee pistons buckle, body collapses on its side, remaining wrist opens involuntarily.

industrial_04.name: Foreman Node
industrial_04.visual: Central cylindrical command pod with one circular eye, four radiating fabrication arms and six docking bay slots underneath. Outer panel petals fold open to reveal mini-bot slots.
industrial_04.pivots: Use six independently hinged docking lids, four tool-arm pivots, whole-body hover and an expanding defensive ring.
industrial_04.ai: Retreats to 5–7 u. Summons only if under alive-unit cap; prioritizes pulse if approached. Existing summoned bots remain after Foreman death.

moves.name: Deploy Cleaners
moves.tell: 1.30 s: lower hatches unfold and fabrication arms cycle
moves.effect: Summons 3 Dust Mites, no direct damage; cap 6 summons alive per Foreman.

moves.name: Defensive Pulse
moves.tell: 0.85 s: cyan perimeter ring turns red and expands
moves.effect: Pushes nearby player back and deals 9 damage.

moves.name: Assembly Barrage
moves.tell: 0.70 s: front arms unfold and two barrels align
moves.effect: Fires 2 short-range scrap projectiles for 6 damage each.

industrial_04.elite: Wider command halo, orange docking doors, 4 Mites per wave, and 3 s of temporary armor on new bots. Still obeys total summon cap of 6. Elite HP 195.
industrial_04.death: Doors pop open; fabrication arms lose synchronization; eye flashes red; levitation cuts and pod drops straight down. Existing summons remain alive.

industrial_05.name: Cable Snare Unit
industrial_05.visual: Narrow rectangle chassis on three hinged legs, exposed circular cable drum, telescoping claw on one disproportionately long arm, small rear balance weight.
industrial_05.pivots: Cable reel rotates; claw jaws open independently; telescope arm sections; cable is a line rendered between spool and claw.
industrial_05.ai: Holds 3.5–6 u range and tries to catch the player before melee. Hook can be dodged or broken with a defined escape input; never drags through walls.

moves.name: Grapple Launch
moves.tell: 0.75 s: thin targeting line locks onto one lane, claw jaws open
moves.effect: Fires claw up to 6 u; contact deals 6 damage and enables Cable Reel.

moves.name: Cable Reel
moves.tell: 0.25 s: cable tightens visibly after a successful hook
moves.effect: Pulls player toward unit for up to 0.75 s; stops at solid geometry; no extra damage.

moves.name: Clamp Strike
moves.tell: 0.40 s: claw opens wide, short 70° cone appears
moves.effect: Short mechanical chop for 13 damage.

industrial_05.elite: Second spool and mirrored claw arm. A missed first hook can trigger a second, with its own 0.75 s targeting tell. Elite HP 120.
industrial_05.death: Spool overspins, cable whips down harmlessly, drum breaks free, tripod folds and collapses into a coil of loose wire.

industrial_06.name: Phase Custodian
industrial_06.visual: Slim long-limbed android: vertically stacked rectangular body panels, elongated hinge arms, rectangular head, segmented legs and narrow baton. Keep shoulder width notably narrow.
industrial_06.pivots: Separate torso plates for phase effect; arm/leg joints for lunges; floor destination decal persists until arrival.
industrial_06.ai: Prefers flanking, not guaranteed rear teleports. Never attacks during invisibility; the landing point and slash direction remain visible before damage.

moves.name: Phase Step
moves.tell: 0.60 s: body segments flicker; a destination marker appears
moves.effect: Moves instantly to the selected visible floor marker; no damage.

moves.name: Ambush Slash
moves.tell: 0.45 s AFTER reappearing: shoulder winds back and arc flashes
moves.effect: Fast blade strike for 14 damage toward locked facing.
moves.recovery: 0.65 s weapon passes target and pauses.

moves.name: Shock Baton
moves.tell: 0.55 s: narrow baton lights cyan and a 2 u line is marked
moves.effect: Short electrical jab for 10 damage.

industrial_06.elite: Twice blinks between separate marked positions; harmless afterimage remains at each. Final Ambush Slash retains full tell. Elite HP 120.
industrial_06.death: Flickers between opacity states, panels separate vertically and crumble into glowing fragments; last grounded shadow fades only after defeat.

industrial_07.name: Signal Scrambler
industrial_07.visual: Spherical switchboard core with protruding antenna needles, two rotating edge dials, and a circular projector ring. A distinct spiky ring silhouette from above.
industrial_07.pivots: Antenna telescopes, dial pointers rotate separately, outer ring scales with each pulse.
industrial_07.ai: Hovers behind allies; does not hide attack telegraphs, distort controls, or invert camera input. Debuff uses a visible player-status icon.

moves.name: Interference Pulse
moves.tell: 0.85 s: needles align and cyan boundary turns amber
moves.effect: Radial 3.5 u wave; on hit, slows ability-energy regeneration 40% for 3 s.

moves.name: Static Jitter
moves.tell: 0.50 s: three small marked floor disks appear
moves.effect: Fires short electrical arcs toward disks, 6 damage on impact.

moves.name: Channel Drift
moves.tell: 0.35 s: screen flashes blue
moves.effect: Slides sideways 2 u, breaks target tracking; no damage.

industrial_07.elite: Extra concentric antenna ring and amber top beacon. Sends two slower concentric pulses 0.55 s apart, each dodgeable separately. Elite HP 90.
industrial_07.death: Antennas retract out of sequence, dials spin backward uncontrollably, outer ring falls, and the central sphere cracks into halves.

industrial_08.name: Conveyor Hound
industrial_08.visual: Low six-legged mechanical dog with two long conveyor belts on its flanks, a mouth of stacked feed rollers, and small square warning lamps over the jaw. Low horizontal silhouette.
industrial_08.pivots: Six leg hinges; each side belt scrolls independently; roller jaws spin; chest compresses before bursts.
industrial_08.ai: Tracks at 3–6 u, commits to one straight lane before chasing, and never homes during the high-speed portion.

moves.name: Belt-Line Chase
moves.tell: 0.75 s: flank belts briefly reverse, jaws chatter; 1 u-wide floor lane
moves.effect: Accelerates to 9 u/s and runs straight up to 7 u; bites at the end for 18 damage.
moves.recovery: 0.85 s belt overrun carries it past the target.

moves.name: Roller Snap
moves.tell: 0.40 s: top roller lifts and jaw gap widens
moves.effect: 1.4 u bite cone for 10 damage.

moves.name: Belt Shred
moves.tell: 0.65 s: leg braces lower; side belt spins bright
moves.effect: Short 2 u lateral scrape dealing 8 damage along its flank.

industrial_08.elite: Secondary upper belt and longer jaw housing. Can follow first charge with a clearly indicated reverse charge at 70% speed. Elite HP 135.
industrial_08.death: Legs mis-time; side belts spin off their shafts; jaw rollers seize and body skids forward trailing harmless sparks.

industrial_09.name: Link Crawlers
industrial_09.dimensions: 0.22 × 0.4 × 0.25 u per link; 5 links per chain
industrial_09.visual: Miniature conveyor-chain centipedes made of rectangular toothed link segments; bright exposed hinge pins and a small flat head plate. Form a narrow articulated train rather than flying discs.
industrial_09.pivots: Each hinge bends independently; segment row stiffens into a single aligned spear for lunges.
industrial_09.ai: Uses short straight bursts rather than surrounding the player. Chain bodies share one attack budget to avoid simultaneous multi-link hits.

moves.name: Linked Spear
moves.tell: 0.65 s: segments snap rigid; straight narrow lane appears
moves.effect: Whole chain lunges 3 u, 11 damage if struck by head.

moves.name: Tail Whip
moves.tell: 0.35 s: rear links curl left, 90° arc lights
moves.effect: Last 3 links sweep for 6 damage.

moves.name: Chain Scatter
moves.tell: 0.40 s: hinge lights flash in sequence
moves.effect: Splits briefly into 2 smaller independently targetable groups, no damage.

industrial_09.elite: Six heavier links with gold hinge pins. After Linked Spear it immediately telegraphs a second Tail Whip from the other side. Elite chain 100 HP total.
industrial_09.death: Hinge sparks propagate front-to-back; links release one by one and clatter into a short line of debris.

industrial_10.name: Gearburst Canister
industrial_10.visual: Armored squat rolling drum with eight radial seam slots and spring-loaded toothed gears inside. Removable outer annular armor is visually obvious.
industrial_10.pivots: One drum roll pivot; eight radial shutters; outer ring becomes detached during recovery.
industrial_10.ai: Moves slowly toward middle of room then bursts at distance. Reliable gaps between gear rays are mandatory.

moves.name: Eight-Gear Burst
moves.tell: 0.95 s: seam lines glow and gears rattle inward; eight radial lanes appear
moves.effect: Ejects 8 slowly traveling straight-line gears, 10 damage each (one-hit cooldown per volley).
moves.recovery: 0.9 s outer armor ring opens exposing the center.

moves.name: Rolling Pinch
moves.tell: 0.50 s: drum tips toward player, two side indicators flash
moves.effect: Rolls 2.5 u along a short lane, 9 collision damage.

moves.name: Spring Pop
moves.tell: 0.60 s: top hatch vibrates, small center disk glows
moves.effect: Vertical gear pops above unit and lands in marked 1 u circle for 8 damage.

industrial_10.elite: Ten-sided gear barrel, upgraded steel ring. Fires an initial eight-lane burst then a separately warned burst rotated by 22.5°. Elite HP 120.
industrial_10.death: Ring detaches, springs discharge harmlessly, drum unrolls on its side and individual metal teeth slide free.

industrial_11.name: Shearblade
industrial_11.visual: Tall slim automaton with two enormous crossed scissor blades as arms, exposed chest hinge, narrow piston legs and a very small faceplate.
industrial_11.pivots: Big opposed shoulder hinges, rotating scissor pivot, torso tilt, knee flex. Mark narrow closing V rather than a generic circle.
industrial_11.ai: Approaches diagonally and forces short dodges across a narrowing V. Vulnerable hinge is exposed during long recovery.

moves.name: Closing V
moves.tell: 0.65 s: both blades open and narrow V is projected
moves.effect: Two-stage crossing cut aimed at the player’s previous position, 10 + 12 damage if hit twice.
moves.recovery: 0.80 s blades lock closed, exposing hinge.

moves.name: One-Side Snip
moves.tell: 0.40 s: one blade rotates 90° outward
moves.effect: Fast diagonal cut for 9 damage.

moves.name: Hinge Lunge
moves.tell: 0.65 s: torso compresses and a thin lane appears
moves.effect: Stabs with joined blade tips 2.5 u forward for 13 damage.
moves.recovery: 0.65 s tip catches in floor briefly.

industrial_11.elite: Visible four-blade scissors with red center pivot. Closing V alternates two diagonal sectors with a 0.4 s gap. Elite HP 143.
industrial_11.death: Blade lock freezes; shoulder springs eject; two long blades fall outward and the central hinge splits.

industrial_12.name: Presswall Worker
industrial_12.visual: Broad heavy two-legged industrial worker holding a rectangular sliding press plate in front. Exaggerated side hydraulic pistons and tracks allow the plate to shift beyond the arms.
industrial_12.pivots: Shield runs on side-mounted telescoping rails; piston legs plant; shoulder blocks show visible exposed flanks.
industrial_12.ai: Moves toward allies to provide frontal cover. Cannot guard while shoving or track-slamming; player should flank rather than wait.

moves.name: Press-Plate Shove
moves.tell: 0.80 s: side pistons brace; rectangular lane appears
moves.effect: Plate drives 2.4 u forward for 17 damage and knockback.
moves.recovery: 1.0 s plate overshoots, exposing its left side.

moves.name: Front Guard
moves.tell: 0.25 s: plate clicks into upright track
moves.effect: Blocks 85% frontal damage in 140° sector for up to 2.0 s.
moves.recovery: 0.5 s plate lowers and side joints expose.

moves.name: Side Track Slam
moves.tell: 0.70 s: plate slides toward one side; off-center rectangle lights
moves.effect: Wide side smash for 12 damage.

industrial_12.elite: Thicker press plate with twin red hydraulic rails. Guard becomes 160° but after shove both lateral pistons are vulnerable. Elite HP 240.
industrial_12.death: Hydraulic rails fail asymmetrically; shield slams face down, torso pitches over it, and piston legs fold.

industrial_13.name: Torque Thief
industrial_13.visual: Crooked short-limbed tool-stealing robot; one shoulder higher than the other, exposed oversize wrist gears and a backpack capacitor drum.
industrial_13.pivots: Hands open claw fingers, wrist gears reverse, shoulder hunches and energy capacitor fills.
industrial_13.ai: Uses Torque Swipe at melee range, then backs off to discharge or escape. Energy-stealing move needs an especially obvious tell.

moves.name: Torque Swipe
moves.tell: 0.55 s: wrist gears reverse; narrow crescent appears
moves.effect: Close swipe for 8 damage and steals 12 ability-energy points on hit (never below zero).
moves.recovery: 0.70 s gears stall storing stolen charge.

moves.name: Charged Toss
moves.tell: 0.75 s: backpack capacitor glows and one gear opens
moves.effect: Tosses a slow charged cog for 9 damage; no energy drain.

moves.name: Gear Feint
moves.tell: 0.35 s: one claw clicks open; no red attack decal
moves.effect: Quick sidestep 1.6 u; does not damage or steal.

industrial_13.elite: Two enlarged geared wrists and twin capacitor lamps. Swipe steals 18 energy; Charged Toss remains unchanged. Elite HP 113.
industrial_13.death: Wrist gears jam in opposite directions, energy escapes in harmless arcs, and crooked arms snap into a rigid pose as body falls.

industrial_14.name: Crane Hooker
industrial_14.visual: Ground-walking portal crane with four blocky legs, tall overhead horizontal beam, suspended iron claw on chain and winch housing. Large rectangular upper silhouette.
industrial_14.pivots: Boom rotates separately; chain length adjustable; hanging claw casts a growing shadow on floor; winch drum spins.
industrial_14.ai: Avoids tight corners and seeks lanes near presses. Drag terminates at obstacles and never guarantees environmental damage; claw itself is dodgeable.

moves.name: Overhead Grab
moves.tell: 0.85 s: claw rises; circular floor shadow tracks, then locks
moves.effect: Drops claw into marked disk for 8 damage; on hit hooks player.
moves.recovery: 0.75 s winch jams if it misses.

moves.name: Hazard Drag
moves.tell: 0.30 s: hooked chain pulls taut
moves.effect: Drags caught player up to 2.5 u toward existing marked stamped lane; no damage from reel itself.

moves.name: Boom Sweep
moves.tell: 0.80 s: overhead beam turns; long narrow strip lights
moves.effect: Swings hanging hook through a 130° arc for 14 damage.

industrial_14.elite: Double cable claw and taller beam. Telegraphed two-circle drop in sequence, not simultaneous. Elite HP 173.
industrial_14.death: Cable frays, top beam tips, claw lands separately and the crane body folds under the weight of its own boom.

industrial_15.name: Chain Binder
industrial_15.visual: Squat chain-coiling machine with twin circular drums, scissoring hook arms and a low box chassis. Crossed hanging chains are clear even from above.
industrial_15.pivots: Two reel pivots, both claw arms independently yaw; loop renders as a closed line for player feedback.
industrial_15.ai: Tries to cut off narrow routes rather than approach directly; crossed telegraph must leave clear side openings.

moves.name: Chain Loop
moves.tell: 0.70 s: twin hooks fan outward; crossed red lanes appear
moves.effect: Throws a short loop 3.5 u; catches and pulls for up to 0.6 s, 6 damage on impact.
moves.recovery: 0.70 s chain snares own axle after miss.

moves.name: Scissor Hook
moves.tell: 0.45 s: claws separate on two sides
moves.effect: Two hooks close into a 1.6 u front cone for 11 damage.

moves.name: Chain Lash
moves.tell: 0.65 s: left reel accelerates, sideways line lights
moves.effect: Sweeps one tether through 100° for 9 damage.

industrial_15.elite: Adds top drum and third hook forming a triangular capture zone with a marked escape wedge. Elite HP 135.
industrial_15.death: Hooks cross and seize, reels overheat, one chain snaps harmlessly upward, body tips forward and settles.

industrial_16.name: Cinder Kettle
industrial_16.visual: Floating copper kettle with half-sphere lid, pointed hot spout, two steam-jet fins and one glowing firebox window beneath the belly.
industrial_16.pivots: Spout yaw; hinged lid rattle; fins flap; jet nozzles expand during bursts.
industrial_16.ai: Flies in lazy circles then commits to a short pour lane. Its shadow always remains visible on floor.

moves.name: Ember Pour
moves.tell: 0.65 s: lid rattles and a narrow moving lane lights
moves.effect: Darts over a 4 u lane while laying a 1.5 s ember ribbon; crossing burns 5 damage/s.
moves.recovery: 0.75 s kettle rattles empty and recharges.

moves.name: Scalding Spit
moves.tell: 0.55 s: spout reddens and tilts downward
moves.effect: Short ember blob for 9 damage in targeted direction.

moves.name: Pressure Hop
moves.tell: 0.35 s: twin jets flare white
moves.effect: Repositions diagonally 2 u; deals no damage.

industrial_16.elite: Two spouts with crossed pouring lanes and a larger black lid; lanes fire sequentially with a 0.4 s gap. Elite HP 83.
industrial_16.death: Lid blows open without damage, firebox flickers blue then black, steam fins sputter and the empty kettle falls and dents.

industrial_17.name: Soot Torpedo
industrial_17.visual: Low charcoal-black rocket trolley with triangular nose bumper, two narrow skid runners and one massive rear furnace bell.
industrial_17.pivots: Furnace bell expansion, front suspension, side exhaust flaps, body recoil after wall impact.
industrial_17.ai: Seeks clear straight lanes. Ricochet direction is predictable and visible before launch; only one reflection.

moves.name: Ricochet Rocket
moves.tell: 0.85 s: ignition coughs twice and a smoky straight lane appears
moves.effect: Rockets at 11 u/s for up to 6 u, ricochets once off wall; 19 damage on contact.
moves.recovery: 1.1 s exhaust sputters and engine stalls.

moves.name: Soot Blast
moves.tell: 0.55 s: side vents open and triangular cone appears
moves.effect: Point-blank rear exhaust burst for 10 damage.

moves.name: Ignition Skip
moves.tell: 0.40 s: furnace flashes orange
moves.effect: Short fixed-angle hop 1.5 u; no contact damage.

industrial_17.elite: Two rear furnace bells and bright orange exhaust shutters; gains a second short final thrust after ricochet, with new red floor lane. Elite HP 150.
industrial_17.death: Rear furnace cools unevenly, wheel runners shear, exhaust bell falls off and chassis skids until it stops.

industrial_18.name: Condensate Mortar
industrial_18.visual: Copper samovar tank mounted on four insulated cuboid legs, curved swan-neck spout, pressure cap on top and a visible condensation coil.
industrial_18.pivots: Spout elevation and swivel, lid lift, pressure cap rotation, droplet particles tracking projectile path.
industrial_18.ai: Holds long range and attacks with parabolic projectiles. No puddle stacks damage with a second puddle.

moves.name: Scalding Lob
moves.tell: 0.80 s: water beads along spout; target circle locks
moves.effect: Lobs a globule into a marked 1.5 u disk, 12 splash damage; leaves 1 s steam puddle.

moves.name: Twin Drip
moves.tell: 0.55 s: spout points twice, two landing circles appear
moves.effect: Two weaker lobs for 7 damage each in successive marked locations.

moves.name: Safety Valve Jet
moves.tell: 0.65 s: top cap lifts, 90° nearby cone glows
moves.effect: Close steam fan for 9 damage.

industrial_18.elite: Two asymmetric curved spouts and larger condensation collar; alternates two different lob arcs with separate landing warnings. Elite HP 113.
industrial_18.death: Pressure cap twists loose, hot reservoir leaks harmless vapor, four support legs collapse one after another.

industrial_19.name: Soot Midges
industrial_19.visual: Dense ash insect cloud formed from five black bead-like bodies with tiny copper wings and prominent pinprick orange eyes. Cloud has one collective hitbox rather than five invisible hits.
industrial_19.pivots: Each midge wing pivots and trails particulate smoke; whole flock compresses to a thin vertical line.
industrial_19.ai: Slow circling between aggressive linear dives. Damage is capped by single flock hitbox.

moves.name: Needle Dive
moves.tell: 0.70 s: flock collapses into a black vertical needle with orange eyes
moves.effect: Dashes along a 4 u lane for 12 damage using one shared hitbox.
moves.recovery: 0.70 s cloud loses cohesion and drifts.

moves.name: Ash Burst
moves.tell: 0.60 s: wingbeats accelerate and ring appears beneath flock
moves.effect: Expands into 2 u smoke burst for 8 damage, then disperses.

moves.name: Flock Fold
moves.tell: 0.35 s: cloud dims and swirls
moves.effect: Swaps from loose formation to narrow travel form; no damage.

industrial_19.elite: Longer spear-cloud with brighter eyes, performs two clearly warned short dives from orthogonal directions. Elite HP 100 group.
industrial_19.death: Cloud collapses inward as eye sparks die; each little wing loses lift, leaving falling ash that evaporates without dealing damage.

industrial_20.name: Spark Wisps
industrial_20.dimensions: 0.25 u diameter each; 4–5 motes per group
industrial_20.visual: Tiny bright flame motes each ringed by a brass ignition coil; thin orange lines dynamically link nearby motes into a zigzag chain.
industrial_20.pivots: Mote coils orbit, link ribbons stretch, each ignition pulse alternates brightness; motes have separate shadows.
industrial_20.ai: Wanders in four- or five-mote chains. Keeping motes separated stops chain attacks; all damage is cooldown-capped.

moves.name: Linked Ignition
moves.tell: 0.80 s: visible orange threads link three nearby motes
moves.effect: One chained ignition jumps between linked members; 8 damage per touched unit, max 16 per sequence.
moves.recovery: 0.70 s threads burn out after one pass.

moves.name: Spark Flick
moves.tell: 0.40 s: one mote brightens white
moves.effect: Small straight bolt for 6 damage.

moves.name: Chain Rearrange
moves.tell: 0.50 s: threads disconnect and reform
moves.effect: Motes relocate within 2 u without damaging.

industrial_20.elite: Six motes including a larger central conductor. Linked Ignition can extend one more hop; conductor flashes a clear second warning. Elite total HP 126.
industrial_20.death: Connections snap one at a time, coils fall as tiny brass rings, flames wink out in sequence.

industrial_21.name: Grate Mauler
industrial_21.visual: Massive square furnace grate torso on piston legs, two huge burning grate fists and a wide barred face with orange light behind slats.
industrial_21.pivots: Fist pistons extend separately; vent slats brighten and open; legs brace widely.
industrial_21.ai: Heavy plodding pursuit. Cannot rotate mid-double-punch; flanks are its weakness.

moves.name: Furnace Double Punch
moves.tell: 0.75 s: both elbows spread and slats turn orange
moves.effect: Two slow forward punches 0.4 s apart, 15 damage each, each creating a 0.7 u hot circle.
moves.recovery: 0.95 s fists cool, retract through grate.

moves.name: Hot Shoulder
moves.tell: 0.65 s: torso leans and one side heats
moves.effect: Short 2 u shoulder check for 13 damage.

moves.name: Grate Flare
moves.tell: 0.90 s: slats spread and a narrow cone lights
moves.effect: Front-facing burst of embers for 12 damage.

industrial_21.elite: White heated grates and twin piston braces; adds an independently telegraphed third stomp only after two punches. Elite HP 233.
industrial_21.death: Fists stop mid-motion, grate light dies from white to ember, front bars separate and heavy chest falls onto knees.

industrial_22.name: Ash Shunter
industrial_22.visual: Slender soot-black service knight with cylindrical pressure joints, long valve-wheel polearm, chimney-collar shoulder plates and tiny lit visor.
industrial_22.pivots: Separate polearm shaft and turning valve-wheel tip; hip-backstep pivot and two-handed sweep grips.
industrial_22.ai: Engages at 2.5–3 u; alternates a three-stage thrust-backstep-sweep with independent short pokes when cornered.

moves.name: Valve Thrust
moves.tell: 0.45 s: polearm spins once then aligns with a thin lane
moves.effect: Long 3 u thrust for 12 damage.

moves.name: Backward Step
moves.tell: 0.20 s: foot pistons retract
moves.effect: Retreats 1.5 u, no damage; leaves a visible safe interval.

moves.name: Wide Pole Sweep
moves.tell: 0.70 s: weapon comes to side, 160° arc appears
moves.effect: Large sweep for 16 damage after backstep.
moves.recovery: 0.85 s valve-wheel tip catches briefly in floor.

industrial_22.elite: Dual spinning valve rings on polehead; wide sweep ends in a short ember burst warned by orange wheel glow. Elite HP 143.
industrial_22.death: Polearm digs into floor and stays; its neck valve vents, torso sinks and the service knight topples without creating a flame hazard.

industrial_23.name: Heat Mirage
industrial_23.visual: Very thin glowing radiator walker with two broad horizontal refractive heat fins, a small metal core and long straight support legs.
industrial_23.pivots: Fin unfold mechanism produces mirage distortion; real shadow always present beneath body.
industrial_23.ai: Offsets confusion with consistent cues: only real model casts solid shadow, attack decals never distort, decoys cannot collide.

moves.name: False Advance
moves.tell: 0.70 s: two refracted false silhouettes appear with no solid shadows
moves.effect: Harmless phantom lunges forward, then real body stabs along clearly marked line for 13 damage.
moves.recovery: 0.70 s cooling fins open wide to clear illusion.

moves.name: Heat Ripple
moves.tell: 0.85 s: ring shimmers but hazard border stays crisp
moves.effect: Wave reduces player visibility only inside limited local haze for 2 s; no direct damage, clear floor markers retained.

moves.name: Radiator Jab
moves.tell: 0.45 s: real core glows brighter than decoys
moves.effect: Short metal stab for 8 damage.

industrial_23.elite: Three false silhouettes and a large red core in the real body. Only one copy produces a normal shadow; final attack retains 0.7 s telegraph. Elite HP 105.
industrial_23.death: Heat fins fan fully out then shatter into harmless sparks; fake figures dissolve first; radiator core hits floor with metallic ping.

industrial_24.name: Forge Bellows
industrial_24.visual: Four-legged mobile forge bellows with accordion leather chest, metal compression frame, fan-shaped rear housing and orange vented exhaust.
industrial_24.pivots: Accordion folds independently; all four legs have simple hinges; glowing heat tethers attach to buffed allies.
industrial_24.ai: Tries to remain behind melee allies; active buff link is visibly breakable by killing or distancing the bellows.

moves.name: Weapon Reheat
moves.tell: 0.95 s: bellows pull wide and target weapon turns amber
moves.effect: Heats one allied melee weapon for 4 s: +25% attack damage and a purely visual ember trail.
moves.recovery: 0.75 s bellows fold flat and relight slowly.

moves.name: Ember Puff
moves.tell: 0.60 s: back nozzle swells, short cone appears
moves.effect: Blows embers 2 u for 9 damage.

moves.name: Draft Escape
moves.tell: 0.35 s: leg pistons flare
moves.effect: Backsteps 1.8 u with no damage.

industrial_24.elite: Twin accordion chambers and two visible orange hoses. Can heat two allies at once, no stacking bonuses. Elite HP 128.
industrial_24.death: Leather folds burst, rear fan wobbles free, orange exhaust fades to black and all four legs flatten.

industrial_25.name: Corrosion Eel
industrial_25.visual: Serpentine line of 7 linked corroded pipe segments, syringe-shaped iron head, thin elbow joint fins and luminous acid flowing along transparent slots.
industrial_25.pivots: Seven rotating pipe hinges; head syringe plunger telescopes; head-to-tail glow travels during startup.
industrial_25.ai: Occupies narrow lanes and turns only at indicated bend. Never spontaneously tracks the player after charge begins.

moves.name: Pivot Rush
moves.tell: 0.75 s: pipe segments stiffen and luminous fluid runs toward head; two linked floor lanes display one pivot
moves.effect: Head-first rush 6 u with exactly one predetermined bend, 17 damage.
moves.recovery: 0.85 s corroded joints seize; tail is exposed.

moves.name: Syringe Jab
moves.tell: 0.45 s: head piston compresses; 2.5 u line glows
moves.effect: Extends head syringe forward for 11 damage.

moves.name: Acid Flick
moves.tell: 0.60 s: rear pipe twitches and droplets collect
moves.effect: Whips tail to scatter two small 1 s acid drops, 3 damage/s each, nonstacking.

industrial_25.elite: Nine pipe segments and two clearly painted pivot nodes. Can make two sharp bends in a rush, each marked during windup. Elite HP 143.
industrial_25.death: Fluid stops circulating; head plunger droops, hinges freeze sequentially from head to tail, body spills into a loose pile of pipes.

industrial_26.name: Rust Lice
industrial_26.visual: Tiny rust-orange mechanical arthropods with spiky scrap-shell backs, four angled legs and clawed hook mandibles.
industrial_26.pivots: Claws latch, individual legs kick, and shell flakes shed small harmless particles.
industrial_26.ai: Group attacks are staggered and at most one louse can cling at once; a sweep or dodge dislodges attachments without ongoing lockout.

moves.name: Clinging Leap
moves.tell: 0.50 s: rust flakes shake off and claws brace against floor
moves.effect: Leaps up to 2.2 u and attaches to player; 3 damage on hit then 2 damage/s for at most 2 s.
moves.recovery: 0.50 s after being shaken off, lands upside down.

moves.name: Mandible Nibble
moves.tell: 0.30 s: front pincers chatter
moves.effect: Short bite for 4 damage when near player.

moves.name: Scuttle Scatter
moves.tell: 0.40 s: all legs extend visibly
moves.effect: Rapidly breaks formation; no direct damage.

industrial_26.elite: One larger plated louse leader with visible ocher crest; leader directs a synchronized two-unit leap, still respects single-attachment cap. Elite pack HP increased 40%.
industrial_26.death: Carapace crumbles, legs curl, sparks pop from the mandibles and each louse rolls onto its back before fading.

industrial_27.name: Etch Claw
industrial_27.visual: Lean six-limbed etching frame with two large acid-filled claw tips, four smaller stabilizing legs, and chest-mounted wash vat connected by narrow tubing.
industrial_27.pivots: Twin front claws have yaw/roll pivots; inner acid cylinders extend; chest rinse valves open and close.
industrial_27.ai: Pursues at mid-close range, uses lateral step to find V-angle. Short-lived corrosion only where tips touch the floor, not a giant poison puddle.

moves.name: Cross-Etch
moves.tell: 0.55 s: both claws spread and narrow V lights on floor
moves.effect: Two quick crossing slashes, 10 then 11 damage; 1 s corrosive patch only at two impact endpoints.
moves.recovery: 0.80 s claw tips immerse in chest vat and rinse.

moves.name: Acid Needle
moves.tell: 0.50 s: one claw tip extends like a lance
moves.effect: Short 2.4 u stab for 9 damage.

moves.name: Etching Step
moves.tell: 0.35 s: rear legs bend laterally
moves.effect: Quickly sidesteps 1.5 u; no damage.

industrial_27.elite: Three acid channels per claw and red rinse tank. Cross-Etch adds a third narrowly telegraphed finishing puncture after wash delay. Elite HP 158.
industrial_27.death: Acid lines reverse into wash vat, twin claws lock open and then detach; four walking legs fold in sequence.

industrial_28.name: Leech Harvester
industrial_28.visual: Slim siphon harvesting robot with four long flexible segmented proboscises, an open transparent belly pump, and short angled metal legs.
industrial_28.pivots: Four independent articulated siphon tips; visible pumping diaphragm; capture tether is a physical line.
industrial_28.ai: Seeks isolated targets 3–5 u away; a successful siphon never becomes indefinite immobilization. Belly pump is an exposed punish point.

moves.name: Siphon Hook
moves.tell: 0.70 s: two proboscises widen and a needle-thin 4.5 u lane appears
moves.effect: Hooks target for 5 contact damage then slowly reels up to 1.8 u.

moves.name: Health Siphon
moves.tell: 0.30 s: on successful hook belly pump flashes
moves.effect: Drains 3 HP/s for maximum 2 s; restored enemy HP capped at 6. Breakable by dodge or strike.
moves.recovery: 0.75 s pump overfills and sputters on failed hold.

moves.name: Proboscis Jab
moves.tell: 0.45 s: one tube straightens
moves.effect: Short puncture for 10 damage.

industrial_28.elite: Two extra transparent pump vessels and four separately aiming tubes. Hook has wider warning angle but siphon duration stays capped at 2 s. Elite HP 143.
industrial_28.death: Belly pump overfills, transparent reservoir cracks, fluid pressure drops and four tubes curl inward as unit folds.

industrial_29.name: Vapor Walker
industrial_29.visual: Hollow chemical-protection suit silhouette with a transparent glass dome mask, visible inner framework and translucent flowing vapor inside sleeves. Heavy boots anchor materialization.
industrial_29.pivots: Separate vapor layer and suit panels; mask iris; vent spawn markers projected onto floor; humanlike walking joints.
industrial_29.ai: Never appears without a floor marker. Real materialized suit casts a shadow; vent transit does not permit attacks.

moves.name: Vent Transit
moves.tell: 0.70 s: shell dissolves into colored vapor as TWO floor vents light
moves.effect: Travels between marked vent mouths; hidden during travel, cannot damage player during transit.
moves.recovery: 0.45 s suit re-forms at destination, leaving condensate droplets.

moves.name: Poison Jab
moves.tell: 0.50 s AFTER arrival: syringe baton points at player, cone appears
moves.effect: Short stab for 12 damage and 2 damage/s for 2 s; damage does not stack.

moves.name: Mist Fan
moves.tell: 0.80 s: mask vents flare and 90° arc appears
moves.effect: Creates 1.5 s narrow vapor fan dealing 5 damage/s inside.

industrial_29.elite: Two extra gas cylinders; cycles across three marked vents but reveals the final destination before its jab. Elite HP 113.
industrial_29.death: Suit loses pressure, glass visor cracks, colored vapor escapes harmlessly, empty fabric shell crumples around frame.

industrial_30.name: Contamination Siren
industrial_30.visual: Tall hazard-alarm pillar with concentric black-and-yellow painted warning rings, top rotating beacon, circular speaker diaphragm and heavy bolted base.
industrial_30.pivots: Top beacon rotates; concentric speaker rings expand; base stabilizers anchor during wave.
industrial_30.ai: Stationary for most attacks; wave never removes player input or obscures other enemy tells. Entire ring has a deliberate escape gap.

moves.name: Weakening Siren
moves.tell: 0.90 s: beacon flashes; one warning ring propagates out with a visible gap
moves.effect: A 4.5 u wave applies -25% player attack damage for 3 s ONLY if it connects.
moves.recovery: 0.75 s beacon dims for chemistry reset.

moves.name: Corrosive Ping
moves.tell: 0.60 s: speaker center compresses; short line lights
moves.effect: Straight ultrasonic dart for 8 damage.

moves.name: Alarm Reposition
moves.tell: 0.50 s: footing bolts retract
moves.effect: Slides 1.5 u to safer spot, no damage.

industrial_30.elite: Two offset rotating beacons, alternating ring gaps. Two independently warned weakening waves; debuff never stacks. Elite HP 120.
industrial_30.death: Beacon cracks and dims, loudspeaker cone caves inward, warning rings detach one after another and base tips sideways.

industrial_31.name: Corrosion Shellback
industrial_31.visual: Huge broad armored crustacean-style machine with overlapping etched shell plates, thick short angled legs and a narrow acid-dripping front lip. Back is rounded rather than a flat plate.
industrial_31.pivots: Shell plates slide shut or lift individually; short legs scuttle; rear breathing hinge exposed when venting.
industrial_31.ai: Presses toward the player with a guarded front but slow turning speed. Rear remains fully vulnerable; cannot guard while exposing vents.

moves.name: Shell March
moves.tell: 0.35 s: overlapping front plates lock and amber lights turn solid
moves.effect: Advances 2.5 u protected from 85% frontal damage in 150° arc; touch shove for 7 damage.
moves.recovery: 0.75 s plates must lift to breathe, exposing rear.

moves.name: Acid Lip
moves.tell: 0.75 s: front rim drips and forward semicircle is marked
moves.effect: Splashes 2 u 140° acid fan for 12 damage.

moves.name: Side Scuttle
moves.tell: 0.40 s: side legs flare and one edge lights
moves.effect: Side shove 1.5 u for 9 damage.

industrial_31.elite: Extra overlapping copper-etched plating; shell march now defends 170° front but vents for 1.0 s afterward. Elite HP 255.
industrial_31.death: Front plates peel apart, leg joints seize one side at a time, shell settles with a hollow thud, corrosion dust puffs harmlessly.

industrial_32.name: Vat Lid Warden
industrial_32.visual: Tall refinery biped with a gigantic circular tank lid held to one side, rusted arm bracing it, narrow respirator face and visible valve on lid center.
industrial_32.pivots: Circular lid rotates on arm hinge; elbow and torso pivot for shoves; expose far-side weapon arm behind shield.
industrial_32.ai: Moves with shield angled toward the player, slows turning while guarding. Favors Rotary Lid Shove if flanked, opening its opposite side.

moves.name: Lid Guard
moves.tell: 0.30 s: tank lid faces player and rim becomes amber
moves.effect: Blocks 85% frontal damage over 145° until next move or maximum 2 s.
moves.recovery: 0.45 s shield rotates aside exposing opposite arm.

moves.name: Rotary Lid Shove
moves.tell: 0.75 s: lid spins and broad 120° arc glows
moves.effect: Wide shield shove for 16 damage and small knockback.
moves.recovery: 0.85 s rotating lid exposes unguarded arm.

moves.name: Valve Burst
moves.tell: 0.65 s: lid valve compresses; short cone appears
moves.effect: Chemical vent blast for 11 damage at 2 u.

industrial_32.elite: Two concentric rotating lid rims and red valve hub. Rotary Lid Shove sweeps an extra 45° segment after brief pause, marked separately. Elite HP 218.
industrial_32.death: Shield rim spins too fast and dislodges; lid drops and rolls in a slow harmless circle as guard slumps and visor darkens.
